title: Cami Startup Canvas 單一 YAML 資料庫
description: 結構驗證不取代來源 hash、引用完整性、固定規則一致性與獨立複核驗證。既有 JSON 歷史須透過遷移轉換，不可直接當新紀錄。

core_canvas.description: Active ten-topic, twenty-question Canvas imported explicitly from reviewed bilingual Markdown. Saved answers have not been accepted or scored. Original questions, notes, rules and evaluation records remain unchanged for provenance. Runtime reads this layer from YAML only.
